NOT ALL WHO WANDER ARE LOST

Field notes.

01 / Find your footing

Move with A/D or arrows. Press Space twice for a double jump. On your phone, use the buttons below the forest.

02 / Take what you need

Equip your axe for trees, rocks, and copper-coloured iron veins. Hold Action (E) to gather. Find crystals on high platforms. Walk over shadow drops to collect essence and berries. Supplies regrow at dawn.

03 / Make camp

Return to camp and open Build (B). Build a forge, then craft an iron sword. Combine 8 iron ore, 6 shadow essence, and 2 crystals for a Duskblade; 6 ore and 4 essence for Shadowmail. Backpack (I) stores materials, gear, and berries. Tap a weapon or press X to swap.

04 / Defeat the Hollow King

Nights last 45 seconds. Each night brings faster, tougher, harder-hitting shadows. Eat stored berries with Q. After three nights, bring your Duskblade and Shadowmail to the altar at the far right. Tap its prompt (R) to start. Jump marked charges and shockwaves, then strike during recovery. The King enrages at half health. Win to see your fireworks.

Progress saves in this browser. Switching tabs pauses the adventure.
